name: grid emission factor
source: UNFCCC GHG emissions calculator ver01.1, md5 57d3ffd78a9f5f9980e15feb65f8d986; Electricity, heat, cooling!B192 (Iraq) = 0.93391 kg CO2e/kWh. Claim record claim-record/records/UNF_GRID_IRAQ.json.
_note: The downward levels are filled only where this repository has a
reading. -1 is measured here by perturbation; -2 and -3 are what
the factor rests on physically and this repository has measured
neither, so they carry ABSENT rather than a plausible number.
The upward levels are taken from the workbook's own Disclaimer!A3,

levels.still_acting: which plants are on the margin at the hour the kWh is drawn

quantified.by: not computed anywhere in the workbook

levels.severed: the national generation mix that the factor was averaged over
levels.still_acting: the mix keeps changing after the average was taken; nothing in the workbook re-reads it
